class Solution:
    def insert(self, intervals, newInterval):
        result = []
        i = 0
        n = len(intervals)
        while i < n and intervals[i][1] < newInterval[0]:
            result.append(intervals[i])
            i += 1
        while i < n and intervals[i][0] <= newInterval[1]:
            newInterval[0] = min(newInterval[0], intervals[i][0])
            newInterval[1] = max(newInterval[1], intervals[i][1])
            i += 1
        result.append(newInterval)
        result.extend(intervals[i:])
        return result

        nums[:k] = reversed(nums[:k])
        nums[k:] = reversed(nums[k:])

class Solution:
    def addTwoNumbers(self, l1, l2):
        dummy = ListNode()
        tail = dummy
        carry = 0
        while l1 or l2 or carry:
            total = carry
            if l1:
                total += l1.val
                l1 = l1.next
            if l2:
                total += l2.val
                l2 = l2.next
            carry, digit = divmod(total, 10)
            tail.next = ListNode(digit)
            tail = tail.next
        return dummy.next

import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int rob(int[]a){int[]m=new int[a.length];Arrays.fill(m,-1);return f(a,0,m);} private int f(int[]a,int i,int[]m){if(i>=a.length)return 0;if(m[i]!=-1)return m[i];return m[i]=Math.max(f(a,i+1,m),a[i]+f(a,i+2,m));} }
